# Track lessons

Lessons that belong to a subject track rather than to one industry programme. Each is a notebook
you do, with the same exercises, checks and hints as every other lesson here, and each opens in
Colab, Kaggle or Binder from the links beside it, or in Codespaces or your own Jupyter as
[the README](../README.md#run-it-anywhere) describes; the worked solution and the full rubric come
with enrolment on Synapsa.

## Start from zero

Begin with some Python and take these in order; each needs only the lessons before it.

1. **[The 8 GB track](T00-L01-the-8gb-track/lesson.ipynb)** · ~40 minutes · Python · no lesson to do first<br>
   Build a profiler that measures what any piece of Python really costs in time and memory, rank four implementations of one task on the numbers, and reproduce the compute-tier check every lesson here has to pass.<br>
   <a href="https://colab.research.google.com/github/TarrySingh/Artificial-Intelligence-Deep-Learning-Machine-Learning-Tutorials/blob/master/lessons/T00-L01-the-8gb-track/lesson.ipynb"><picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../brand/readme/open-colab-dark.svg"><img src="../brand/readme/open-colab-light.svg" height="24" alt="Open The 8 GB track in Colab"></picture></a> <a href="https://kaggle.com/kernels/welcome?src=https://github.com/TarrySingh/Artificial-Intelligence-Deep-Learning-Machine-Learning-Tutorials/blob/master/lessons/T00-L01-the-8gb-track/lesson.ipynb"><picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../brand/readme/open-kaggle-dark.svg"><img src="../brand/readme/open-kaggle-light.svg" height="24" alt="Open The 8 GB track in Kaggle"></picture></a> <a href="https://mybinder.org/v2/gh/TarrySingh/Artificial-Intelligence-Deep-Learning-Machine-Learning-Tutorials/master?labpath=lessons/T00-L01-the-8gb-track/lesson.ipynb"><picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../brand/readme/open-binder-dark.svg"><img src="../brand/readme/open-binder-light.svg" height="24" alt="Open The 8 GB track in Binder"></picture></a>

## Orientation

<picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../brand/areas/t00-icon-dark.svg"><img src="../brand/areas/t00-icon-light.svg" width="40" height="40" align="middle" alt=""></picture> **3 lessons**

Start from nothing, on a laptop. Measure what code costs on an 8 GB machine, keep a model registry honest through a model swap, and write one client for three backends.

- **[The 8 GB track](T00-L01-the-8gb-track/lesson.ipynb)** · ~40 minutes · Python · no lesson to do first<br>
  Build a profiler that measures what any piece of Python really costs in time and memory, rank four implementations of one task on the numbers, and reproduce the compute-tier check every lesson here has to pass.<br>
  <a href="https://colab.research.google.com/github/TarrySingh/Artificial-Intelligence-Deep-Learning-Machine-Learning-Tutorials/blob/master/lessons/T00-L01-the-8gb-track/lesson.ipynb"><picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../brand/readme/open-colab-dark.svg"><img src="../brand/readme/open-colab-light.svg" height="24" alt="Open The 8 GB track in Colab"></picture></a> <a href="https://kaggle.com/kernels/welcome?src=https://github.com/TarrySingh/Artificial-Intelligence-Deep-Learning-Machine-Learning-Tutorials/blob/master/lessons/T00-L01-the-8gb-track/lesson.ipynb"><picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../brand/readme/open-kaggle-dark.svg"><img src="../brand/readme/open-kaggle-light.svg" height="24" alt="Open The 8 GB track in Kaggle"></picture></a> <a href="https://mybinder.org/v2/gh/TarrySingh/Artificial-Intelligence-Deep-Learning-Machine-Learning-Tutorials/master?labpath=lessons/T00-L01-the-8gb-track/lesson.ipynb"><picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../brand/readme/open-binder-dark.svg"><img src="../brand/readme/open-binder-light.svg" height="24" alt="Open The 8 GB track in Binder"></picture></a>
- **[A model registry that survives a swap](T00-L02-model-registry/lesson.ipynb)** · ~40 minutes · Python · builds on [The 8 GB track](T00-L01-the-8gb-track/lesson.ipynb)<br>
  Build a role-based model registry, a retirement detector run against a dated snapshot of a provider's model pages, and a golden test that survives a model swap.<br>
  <a href="https://colab.research.google.com/github/TarrySingh/Artificial-Intelligence-Deep-Learning-Machine-Learning-Tutorials/blob/master/lessons/T00-L02-model-registry/lesson.ipynb"><picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../brand/readme/open-colab-dark.svg"><img src="../brand/readme/open-colab-light.svg" height="24" alt="Open A model registry that survives a swap in Colab"></picture></a> <a href="https://kaggle.com/kernels/welcome?src=https://github.com/TarrySingh/Artificial-Intelligence-Deep-Learning-Machine-Learning-Tutorials/blob/master/lessons/T00-L02-model-registry/lesson.ipynb"><picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../brand/readme/open-kaggle-dark.svg"><img src="../brand/readme/open-kaggle-light.svg" height="24" alt="Open A model registry that survives a swap in Kaggle"></picture></a> <a href="https://mybinder.org/v2/gh/TarrySingh/Artificial-Intelligence-Deep-Learning-Machine-Learning-Tutorials/master?labpath=lessons/T00-L02-model-registry/lesson.ipynb"><picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../brand/readme/open-binder-dark.svg"><img src="../brand/readme/open-binder-light.svg" height="24" alt="Open A model registry that survives a swap in Binder"></picture></a>
- **[One client, three backends](T00-L03-one-client-three-backends/lesson.ipynb)** · ~50 minutes · Python · builds on [The 8 GB track](T00-L01-the-8gb-track/lesson.ipynb)<br>
  Build the normalising half of a provider-agnostic LLM client, which reads tool calls, reasoning and JSON out of whatever shape a backend returns, and a compatibility suite that shows what three stand-in backends keep, rename, drop or reject.<br>
  <a href="https://colab.research.google.com/github/TarrySingh/Artificial-Intelligence-Deep-Learning-Machine-Learning-Tutorials/blob/master/lessons/T00-L03-one-client-three-backends/lesson.ipynb"><picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../brand/readme/open-colab-dark.svg"><img src="../brand/readme/open-colab-light.svg" height="24" alt="Open One client, three backends in Colab"></picture></a> <a href="https://kaggle.com/kernels/welcome?src=https://github.com/TarrySingh/Artificial-Intelligence-Deep-Learning-Machine-Learning-Tutorials/blob/master/lessons/T00-L03-one-client-three-backends/lesson.ipynb"><picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../brand/readme/open-kaggle-dark.svg"><img src="../brand/readme/open-kaggle-light.svg" height="24" alt="Open One client, three backends in Kaggle"></picture></a> <a href="https://mybinder.org/v2/gh/TarrySingh/Artificial-Intelligence-Deep-Learning-Machine-Learning-Tutorials/master?labpath=lessons/T00-L03-one-client-three-backends/lesson.ipynb"><picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../brand/readme/open-binder-dark.svg"><img src="../brand/readme/open-binder-light.svg" height="24" alt="Open One client, three backends in Binder"></picture></a>

## Data and statistics

<picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../brand/areas/t01-icon-dark.svg"><img src="../brand/areas/t01-icon-light.svg" width="40" height="40" align="middle" alt=""></picture> **2 lessons**

Statistics by simulation: sampling distributions, bootstrap intervals, permutation tests and power, the habits every later lesson leans on.

- **[Statistics by simulation](T01-L01-statistics-by-simulation/lesson.ipynb)** · ~90 minutes · Python · builds on [The 8 GB track](T00-L01-the-8gb-track/lesson.ipynb)<br>
  Build a simulation toolkit for experiment analysis -- sampling distributions, bootstrap intervals, a permutation test and power calculator -- and audit how peeking and testing twenty metrics inflate false positives<br>
  <a href="https://colab.research.google.com/github/TarrySingh/Artificial-Intelligence-Deep-Learning-Machine-Learning-Tutorials/blob/master/lessons/T01-L01-statistics-by-simulation/lesson.ipynb"><picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../brand/readme/open-colab-dark.svg"><img src="../brand/readme/open-colab-light.svg" height="24" alt="Open Statistics by simulation in Colab"></picture></a> <a href="https://kaggle.com/kernels/welcome?src=https://github.com/TarrySingh/Artificial-Intelligence-Deep-Learning-Machine-Learning-Tutorials/blob/master/lessons/T01-L01-statistics-by-simulation/lesson.ipynb"><picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../brand/readme/open-kaggle-dark.svg"><img src="../brand/readme/open-kaggle-light.svg" height="24" alt="Open Statistics by simulation in Kaggle"></picture></a> <a href="https://mybinder.org/v2/gh/TarrySingh/Artificial-Intelligence-Deep-Learning-Machine-Learning-Tutorials/master?labpath=lessons/T01-L01-statistics-by-simulation/lesson.ipynb"><picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../brand/readme/open-binder-dark.svg"><img src="../brand/readme/open-binder-light.svg" height="24" alt="Open Statistics by simulation in Binder"></picture></a>
- **[How models lie](T01-L02-leakage-clinic/lesson.ipynb)** · ~50 minutes · Python · builds on [The 8 GB track](T00-L01-the-8gb-track/lesson.ipynb) and [Statistics by simulation](T01-L01-statistics-by-simulation/lesson.ipynb)<br>
  Build a leakage clinic — plant five leaks (target, preprocessing, duplicate, group and temporal) in a seeded customer book, measure how much each inflates cross-validated AUC against an oracle ceiling, and write the split, feature and pipeline checks that catch all five<br>
  <a href="https://colab.research.google.com/github/TarrySingh/Artificial-Intelligence-Deep-Learning-Machine-Learning-Tutorials/blob/master/lessons/T01-L02-leakage-clinic/lesson.ipynb"><picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../brand/readme/open-colab-dark.svg"><img src="../brand/readme/open-colab-light.svg" height="24" alt="Open How models lie in Colab"></picture></a> <a href="https://kaggle.com/kernels/welcome?src=https://github.com/TarrySingh/Artificial-Intelligence-Deep-Learning-Machine-Learning-Tutorials/blob/master/lessons/T01-L02-leakage-clinic/lesson.ipynb"><picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../brand/readme/open-kaggle-dark.svg"><img src="../brand/readme/open-kaggle-light.svg" height="24" alt="Open How models lie in Kaggle"></picture></a> <a href="https://mybinder.org/v2/gh/TarrySingh/Artificial-Intelligence-Deep-Learning-Machine-Learning-Tutorials/master?labpath=lessons/T01-L02-leakage-clinic/lesson.ipynb"><picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../brand/readme/open-binder-dark.svg"><img src="../brand/readme/open-binder-light.svg" height="24" alt="Open How models lie in Binder"></picture></a>

Tokenisers from scratch, the BPE merge loop in C++, and a language model trained on a CPU with numpy alone.

- **[Byte-level BPE from scratch](T03-L01-bpe-from-scratch/lesson.ipynb)** · ~60 minutes · Python · builds on [The 8 GB track](T00-L01-the-8gb-track/lesson.ipynb)<br>
  Build byte-level byte pair encoding from scratch, and measure the token tax it imposes on five writing systems.<br>
  <a href="https://colab.research.google.com/github/TarrySingh/Artificial-Intelligence-Deep-Learning-Machine-Learning-Tutorials/blob/master/lessons/T03-L01-bpe-from-scratch/lesson.ipynb"><picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../brand/readme/open-colab-dark.svg"><img src="../brand/readme/open-colab-light.svg" height="24" alt="Open Byte-level BPE from scratch in Colab"></picture></a> <a href="https://kaggle.com/kernels/welcome?src=https://github.com/TarrySingh/Artificial-Intelligence-Deep-Learning-Machine-Learning-Tutorials/blob/master/lessons/T03-L01-bpe-from-scratch/lesson.ipynb"><picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../brand/readme/open-kaggle-dark.svg"><img src="../brand/readme/open-kaggle-light.svg" height="24" alt="Open Byte-level BPE from scratch in Kaggle"></picture></a> <a href="https://mybinder.org/v2/gh/TarrySingh/Artificial-Intelligence-Deep-Learning-Machine-Learning-Tutorials/master?labpath=lessons/T03-L01-bpe-from-scratch/lesson.ipynb"><picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../brand/readme/open-binder-dark.svg"><img src="../brand/readme/open-binder-light.svg" height="24" alt="Open Byte-level BPE from scratch in Binder"></picture></a>
